sourceIssues.detail: The source lists ischemic heart disease/previous MI as a DCM cause. The ESC cardiomyopathy definition distinguishes a DCM phenotype from dysfunction explained solely by coronary disease or abnormal loading.
sourceIssues.handling: Do not key a question that teaches coronary disease alone as sufficient for the strict DCM diagnosis. Other listed contributors remain testable. Source wording needs separate review.

coverageReview.reason: The generated point-to-question map records what is actually tested. It does not certify that the complete source has been reduced to an exhaustive required-point inventory.
coverageReview.rule: An untested clinical fact cannot be reclassified as background merely to make coverage appear complete.
